how_to_collect: Active 3G+ data subscriptions from operators, per 100 inhabitants.
Fixed (wired) broadband subscriber counts filed by ISPs, per 100 inhabitants.
Household survey — male minus female internet-use rate (percentage points).
National household ICT survey — individuals using the internet in the last 3 months, per county.
Active mobile-cellular SIM counts from operators, normalized per 100 inhabitants.
Household survey, rural enumeration areas — share with regular internet access.
Household survey, urban enumeration areas — share with regular internet access.
Household survey, ages 15–24 — internet use in the age group.
Active macro cell sites from the site registry, divided by county land area (per 1,000 km²).
Backbone route survey — share of administrative districts within 10 km of the fiber backbone.
Registered fixed broadband access points (ISP POPs, public access sites) — absolute count per county.
Operator 4G coverage-engineering polygons overlaid on the population grid; share of population covered.
EMIS school census — share of primary/secondary schools with a working internet connection.
School census — enrolment divided by internet-capable learning devices, in connected schools.
Household survey — internet use within the lowest household-income quintile.
Aggregate mobile data traffic divided by active data subscribers (GB per user per month).
Priced entry-level fixed-broadband basket as a % of GNI per capita.
Priced entry-level mobile data-and-voice basket as a % of GNI per capita (county income from survey).
Household survey device-ownership module — adults owning an internet-capable smartphone.
Formal employment reported by registered ICT businesses — job counts per county.
Disclosed annual public + private ICT investment (US$ millions).
National business registry filtered to ICT-sector businesses — absolute count per county.
Registered mobile-money accounts from CBL reporting, per 100 adults.
Cybersecurity incidents formally reported to the national CERT (count per year).
Annual expert scoring (0–100) of data-protection laws and institutional capacity in force. National figure applied to counties.
Registered digital/national IDs usable online, divided by adult population.
Structured audit (0–100) of government services available online. National figure applied to counties.
Formally collected/recycled e-waste tonnage divided by e-waste generated (%).
Device import/take-back registry modelled to kg of e-waste generated per capita.
Share of ICT-sector electricity consumption sourced from renewables (%).
